userMenu: Accessible label of the avatar button that opens the account menu.
search: Label of the search button in the header (opens full-screen search).
mainMenu: Accessible label of the hamburger button that opens the prototype menu.
menuCardRadius: Prototype menu toggle: use a 4 pixel corner radius on cards.
menuModuleOverflowMenus: Prototype menu toggle: show a "⋯" actions menu on each Home module header.
menuHideTabBar: Prototype menu toggle: hide the Home / Explore / Contribute tabs.
menuResetOnboarding: Prototype menu item: start the onboarding (welcome questions) again.
menuResetUrlState: Prototype menu item: clear the prototype state stored in the page URL.
menuResetPrototype: Prototype menu item: reset everything to the initial state.
homeLayout: Accessible label of the configure (gear) button that opens the Home layout settings.
dailyReadsFilters: Default accessible label of a row of filter buttons above a list of cards.
quickNavigation: Accessible label of the floating navigation bar.
home: Accessible label of the floating Home button.
dragToReorder: Accessible label of the drag handle on each row of the Home layout list (also moves with the arrow keys).
interestsEmpty: Shown in a suggestions module when no interests, saved pages or edits are available to base suggestions on.
randomArticles: Heading of the article list in the interests picker when there are no interests yet.
relatedArticles: Heading of the article list in the interests picker, related to the chosen interests.
searchResults: Accessible label of the search suggestions list in the interests picker.
done: Button that saves the chosen interests and closes the picker.
leaveTitle: Title of the dialog shown when a link leaves the prototype for a real wiki.
leaveContinue: Primary button of the leaving-prototype dialog: follow the link.
unpinFromHome: Accessible label of the pin button on a module header, outside Home.
unpinFromTop: Accessible label of the pin button on a module header on Home.
moduleAbout: Module actions menu item. $1 = module title in lowercase (e.g. "trending"), $2 = module title as displayed (e.g. "Trending"); use whichever reads best.
configure: Module actions menu item: opens the personalization settings.
moduleActions: Accessible label of the "⋯" button on a module header.
addedEditedPages: Success message after fetching a user's editing history. $1 = number of pages added.
commaSeparatedTitles: Help text under a text field that takes a list of article titles.
fetch: Button that fetches the editing history of the username entered.
pageCount: Count under a personalization toggle. $1 = number of pages (interests, saved pages, watchlist).
editCount: Count under the Contributions personalization toggle. $1 = number of edited pages.
interestsOrTopics: Personalization toggle: base suggestions on chosen interests.
savedPages: Personalization toggle: base suggestions on saved pages.
contributions: Personalization toggle: base suggestions on the pages the user edited.
splashTitle: Title of the welcome dialog shown when the prototype opens.
splashHowTo: Followed by a numbered list of steps.
